title: Singapore dollar to Chinese yuan, since 1993 (daily from 2003)
description: Yuan per Singapore dollar and Singapore dollars per 100 yuan, each working day from 2003 and each week from 1993: MAS's noon rate where MAS publishes one, and earlier days from the source named on each row.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in yuan, on any day since 1993?

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: cny_per_sgd
fields.meaning: How many yuan one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse of the next column, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: sgd_per_100_cny
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per 100 yuan, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: MAS = MAS, as of noon; MAS weekly = MAS, weekly (before 2003).
